history.title: Download history
settings.split_chapters_tip: The whole file stays, and next to it comes a folder named after the video with one part per chapter (e.g. “01 - Intro”). No re-encoding; a video without chapters is not split.
cookies.note: For videos that need sign-in (private, members only). Cookies are read only on this computer, go only to the site you download from and nothing is stored. Firefox works most reliably: Chrome, Edge and Brave on Windows often refuse to give out their cookies (browser protection), so export a cookies.txt instead. The browser extension still sends the sign-in itself, for the site you are watching.
settings.precise_cut: Cut clips to the exact second (slower)
settings.precise_cut_tip: On: the cut is exactly where you entered it, but the part around the cut is re-encoded. Off (fast cut): no re-encoding and no quality loss, but the clip starts at the nearest keyframe, sometimes a few seconds earlier.
settings.sponsorblock_tip: Cuts the parts marked by SponsorBlock users: sponsor ads, self-promotion and “like and subscribe”. The app asks sponsor.ajay.app with only part of an encoded video ID.

error.drm: The video is DRM-protected (e.g. Netflix, Apple TV+, Disney+) and cannot be downloaded.
error.friendly.bot: The site wants to confirm you're not a robot. Send the video from the browser extension while signed in to the site, or try later.
error.friendly.age: The video is only for signed-in adult users. Send it from the browser extension while signed in to the site.
error.friendly.private: The video is private. It can only be downloaded if you can see it while signed in: send it from the browser extension.
error.friendly.login: The video is only available to signed-in users. Send it from the browser extension while signed in to the site.
error.friendly.geo: The video isn't available in your country.
error.friendly.unavailable: The video is no longer available (it was removed or the link is wrong).
error.friendly.forbidden: The site refused the download. {help} → {update}, then try again.
error.friendly.rate: The site is temporarily limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.friendly.cookies: The browser's cookies can't be read. Close the browser and try again, or choose Firefox or a cookies.txt file in Settings.
error.friendly.network: Can't reach the site. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.friendly.unsupported: This link isn't supported. If it's a video, send it from the browser extension while it plays.
error.friendly.format: The chosen quality isn't available for this video. Pick another format (e.g. best quality).
error.friendly.disk: There isn't enough disk space. Free up space or choose another download folder.
error.friendly.permission: No permission to write to the download folder. Choose another folder.
error.live: This is a live stream and is not downloaded. Download it after the stream ends and the recording is published.

name.title: Title only
history.search: Search by title, link or file name…
help.stores_note: The official extension page opens: in Edge click “Get”, in Firefox “Add to Firefox”. No developer mode, and the extension updates itself afterwards.
help.store_opened: The extension page is opening in the browser.
help.chrome_step1: 1. Copy the path of the extension folder:
help.chrome_step2: 2. Open the extensions page and turn on “Developer mode” (top right):
help.chrome_step3: 3. Click “Load unpacked”, paste the path (Ctrl+V) into the folder field and click “Select Folder”. Finally pin the Video Download icon (puzzle icon → pin).
help.chrome_step3_mac: 3. Click “Load unpacked”, in the folder picker press ⌘⇧G, paste the path (⌘V), press Return and then “Select”. Finally pin the Video Download icon (puzzle icon → pin).
help.usage: How to use: play a video and click the Video Download icon, or right-click a link or video. If the app is not running, the click starts it. Live streams and DRM-protected video (Netflix, Disney+…) are not downloaded.
help.copied_linux: Path copied: in step 3, in the folder picker press Ctrl+L, paste it (Ctrl+V) and press Enter.
help.chrome_step3_linux: 3. Click “Load unpacked”, in the folder picker press Ctrl+L, paste the path (Ctrl+V), press Enter and then “Select”. Finally pin the Video Download icon (puzzle icon → pin).
help.copied_mac: Path copied: in step 3, in the folder picker press ⌘⇧G, paste it (⌘V) and press Return.
help.copied: Path copied: in step 3 paste it into the folder picker (Ctrl+V).
help.opened: The extensions page is opening in the browser.
help.open_failed: The browser didn't open. The address {url} was copied: paste it into the address bar.
status.save_failed: The queue or history could not be saved (folder {folder}). Check that there is disk space.
error.no_output: The download didn't produce a valid file (missing, empty or unreadable). Try again.
update.unsigned: The update isn't signed with this program's key or doesn't match the signature, so it won't be installed.
clipboard.notice: The app watches copied links: when you copy a link to a video, it adds it to the queue (downloading starts only on “Download”). You can also turn this off in the File menu.
error.not_media: The link doesn't lead to a video or audio (e.g. a program, archive, document or plain page).
status.not_media: The link is not a video or audio — skipped: {url}
ytdlp.nightly_offer: If a site still doesn't work, you can try the nightly version of yt-dlp: it has the newest fixes, usually a day or two before the regular release. When a newer regular version comes out, the app switches back on its own. Download the nightly version?
ytdlp.nightly_none: There is no nightly version newer than the one you have.
ytdlp.updated: yt-dlp was updated to {version}; it takes effect the next time the app starts.
ytdlp.checksum: The downloaded yt-dlp failed the SHA-256 check.
update.store: Version {version} from the Microsoft Store: new versions arrive automatically through the Store.
update.dev_only: Version {new} is available. Automatic installation only works in the installed app.
update.checksum: The downloaded file is not valid (SHA-256 mismatch).
update.no_asset: The release has no installer file.
update.no_gh: Updating requires the GitHub CLI (gh) signed in to your account.
mac.move_to_applications: Drag Video Download to the Applications folder and open it from there. Opened like this (from the .dmg or Downloads), the browser extension can't start the app.
update.open_download: Version {new} is downloading in your browser. Open the downloaded .dmg, drag Video Download to Applications (replace the old one) and start the app again.
update.busy: Wait for downloads and MP3 conversions to finish (or stop them), then try again.
